name.ja: 宮崎空港ゴルフセンター

hours.en: 7:00–21:00 (Sundays to 20:00). Closed the fourth Thursday each month (open if a holiday), December 31 and January 1.

price.en: Entry 400 yen (free if you buy coins). Balls: weekday 7:00–17:00 200 for 800 yen / 300 for 1,300 yen, 17:00–21:00 200 for 1,200 / 300 for 1,700 yen. Weekend/holiday 200 for 1,300 / 300 for 1,600 yen. Club rental 200 yen each.

description.ja: 宮崎市赤江の練習場。入場料制。初心者・一般・ジュニアのゴルフスクールあり。
description.en: Driving range in Akae, Miyazaki City. Entry-fee system. Golf school for beginners, general players and juniors.
description.ko: 미야자키시 아카에의 연습장. 입장료 방식. 초보자·일반·주니어 골프 스쿨 있음.
